Arcraft Infotech is looking for ambitious tech enthusiasts and graduates to join our Python Developer & Placement Program.

jobs_results.title: Python Developer — Web Automation & Data Extraction
jobs_results.job_title: Python Developer — Web Automation & Data Extraction
jobs_results.description:
Python Developer — Web Automation & Data Extraction


Company: Vortexen Dynamics Industrial Solutions


About Vortexen Dynamics
Vortexen Dynamics Industrial Solutions is an engineering and industrial solutions company working across areas including protective and industrial coatings, corrosion protection, passive fire protection, oil & gas, marine and industrial projects, and other specialized engineering services.
We are currently developing an internal technology platform focused on automated web research, data collection, and structured company information.


About the Role
We are looking for a Python Developer — Web Automation & Data Extraction to work on the development of our web crawling and data extraction systems.
The role involves building and improving Python-based automation that can navigate websites, collect relevant information, handle different website structures, and process extracted data reliably.


We are looking for someone who enjoys solving practical problems involving Python, websites, automation, crawling, and data extraction.


Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain Python-based web automation and data extraction solutions.
Build and improve web crawlers, spiders, scrapers, and automated data collection workflows.
Work with websites having different structures, page types, and technical behaviors.
Extract useful information from web pages and convert it into structured data.
Work with HTTP requests, HTML, JSON, APIs, and web technologies.
Handle crawling challenges such as redirects, errors, retries, pagination, dynamic content, and changing page structures.
Troubleshoot and improve crawler and extraction performance.
Write clean, maintainable, and testable Python code.
Work with databases or structured storage for collected data.
Monitor and improve the reliability and efficiency of automation processes.
Collaborate with backend and other technical team members as the system develops.

Required Skills

Strong Python programming skills.
Understanding of web technologies and how websites work.
Experience with or strong understanding of web scraping, crawling, or web automation.
Familiarity with HTTP requests, HTML, JSON, and APIs.
Experience with tools or frameworks such as Scrapy, BeautifulSoup, Requests, HTTPX, Selenium, Playwright, or similar technologies.
Ability to troubleshoot technical problems independently.
Understanding of structured data and databases.
Familiarity with Git and basic software development practices.

Good to Have

Experience building crawlers or automation systems at scale.
Experience handling JavaScript-heavy or dynamically generated websites.
Experience with browser automation.
Experience with concurrency, retries, rate limiting, proxies, or similar crawling techniques.
Experience with PostgreSQL, SQLite, or similar databases.
Experience deploying Python applications or automation systems.
Understanding of asynchronous programming in Python.

What We Value

Strong problem-solving ability.
Ability to understand an unfamiliar website and determine how information can be collected from it.
Practical engineering mindset rather than dependence on a particular tool.
Ability to investigate and experiment when websites behave unexpectedly.
Ability to build reliable automation rather than one-off scripts.
Curiosity about how websites, data, and automation work together.

Experience
Relevant experience is preferred, but we are open to candidates with strong practical Python and web automation skills even if their previous job title does not specifically mention Web Scraping or Web Automation.
Candidates from backgrounds such as Python Development, Automation Engineering, Data Extraction, Web Crawling, QA Automation, Browser Automation, Backend Development, or related areas may also be considered.

Location: Infopark, Kochi, Kerala


Work Mode: Hybrid
Employment Type
Full-time
Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹32,000.00 per month


Benefits

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kochi, Kerala (Kochi)

jobs_results.title: Associate Software Developer (Python)
jobs_results.description:
Deloitte India has an immediate opening for a Associate Software Developer (Python) in Kochi. If you are a fresher (or have up to 2 years of experience) looking to build a stable, rewarding career, this role is for you.

As a Associate Software Developer (Python), you will work alongside experienced professionals on real consulting and professional services work in Kochi. You'll get structured onboarding, regular feedback and genuine ownership of your tasks — this role is designed to help freshers grow into confident, capable professionals. Questions are encouraged and your growth is taken seriously.

What you'll do day to day:
• Build and maintain backend services
• Design and consume REST APIs
• Write clean, tested Python code
• Optimise database queries and performance

Skills & tools you'll use: Python, Django, Flask, SQL, REST APIs, Git, OOP, Linux. You'll strengthen the practical, job-ready skills that make a fresher stand out. This is an entry-level role, so limited or no prior experience is fine — a genuine interest in software development, solid fundamentals and a willingness to learn matter far more than a polished CV.

Who should apply: freshers and candidates with 0–2 years of experience (relevant degree/diploma, role-dependent) based in or willing to work from Kochi, Kerala. If you have built or done anything on your own — college projects, freelance work, internships or coursework — that's a strong plus.

In this role you'll gain hands-on experience, professional mentorship and a clear path for growth and internal mobility as you prove yourself. High performers move into higher-responsibility roles quickly.

Ready to start your career with Deloitte India in Kochi? Sign in (or create a free MyInternships.in account) to apply — you must be logged in to apply, and shortlisted candidates are contacted directly. Responsibilities: Build and maintain backend services; Design and consume REST APIs; Write clean, tested Python code; Optimise database queries and performance; Collaborate with the team, document your work and act on feedback. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree / diploma in a relevant field (freshers welcome); Working knowledge of Python, Django, Flask, SQL; 0–2 years of experience (fresh graduates encouraged to apply); Strong communication, ownership and a problem-solving mindset; Based in or willing to relocate to Kochi, Kerala (or remote where applicable).
